definition.determinant_convention: D(z)=det(I-z A), recorded only as a finite-dimensional prefix
definition.primitive_object: lexicographically least rotation of a non-periodic finite branch word
definition.symbolic_pilot: full one-sided shift Sigma_3 on branch alphabet {0,1,2}
definition.trace_log_identity: Tr(A^n)=sum_{d|n} d sum_[w] in P_d tr(B_w^(n/d))
definition.transfer_prefix: 6x6 block matrix A with A_ij=B_j for all i,j
